fact.subject: Black Forest Labs
fact.object: FLUX 3 Image Klein 开放权重图像模型

evidence.quote: Today we are releasing FLUX 3 Image Klein, a 5.6B parameter open weights model for text-to-image generation, image editing and multi-reference generation with up to 10 reference images. It shares core capabilities with the full FLUX 3 Image model: native 4K generation, pixel-perfect editing, and bounding boxes that control where elements are placed or confine edits to a defined area.
With the INT8 build, FLUX 3 Image Klein runs on NVIDIA GeForce RTX GPUs with as little as 8GB of VRAM, through ComfyUI or Diffusers, extending what FLUX.2 [klein] started to even smaller hardware.

The release includes a base model for fine-tuning and a step distilled model for low-latency generation, along with FP8, INT8 and NVFP4 builds developed with NVIDIA support, under the FLUX Kommunity License.

title: FLUX 3 Image Klein: open weights, 5.6B parameters
displayTitle: Black Forest Labs 开放 FLUX 3 Image Klein，8GB 显存可运行量化版
entities: FLUX 3 Image Klein 开放权重图像模型
summary: Black Forest Labs 发布 56 亿参数的 FLUX 3 Image Klein 开放权重图像模型，支持文本生图、最多十张参考图与图像编辑。公司称 INT8 版本可在 8GB 显存 NVIDIA GPU 上运行，权重受 FLUX Kommunity License 约束。
investorNote: 将较高规格图像编辑压到消费级显卡有助本地部署；但性能排名系厂商内部测试，授权范围要单独核对。
narrative: Black Forest Labs 发布 56 亿参数的 FLUX 3 Image Klein，提供基础版与蒸馏版权重，支持文本生图、多参考图和局部编辑。公司称 INT8 版本可在 **8GB 显存** 的 NVIDIA 显卡上运行，并给出 RTX 4070 上的速度测试；这些速度和质量比较来自厂商及合作方条件下的评测，不能直接等同所有终端体验。权重按 FLUX Kommunity License 开放，计划商业化的团队仍需逐项核对授权条件。

eventRelation.reason: 新图像模型发布，和其他厂商大模型、Meta 文本多模态权重不同。
